title: Grilled Ricotta Stuffed Squash Blossoms & Pickled Ramps

methodSections.heading: Pickled Ramps
steps: Clean the ramps thoroughly and place in a mason jar.
Bring the remaining ingredients to a boil and then pour over the ramps.
Allow to cool and then place in the fridge at least overnight before serving.

methodSections.heading: Squash Blossoms
steps: Mix the ricotta, zest, and thyme together in a bowl. Season with salt to taste.
Transfer the mix into a piping bag.
Evenly pipe the mix into each of the blossoms.

methodSections.heading: Vegetables
steps: Sauté all the vegetables in the butter and season with salt.

methodSections.heading: To Plate
steps: Arrange the sautéed vegetables on the serving plates.
Place the basil leaves and a few slices of pickled ramp on top and around the vegetables.
Grill the blossoms over a very high heat until they are just starting to brown.
Place on top of the vegetables and serve immediately.
